en.name: Ham, uncured and cooked
en.summary: An uncured fresh ham is simply a pork leg — no curing salts, no smoke — and once it has been roasted it is a cooked meat like any other roast. It keeps 3–4 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below and 3–4 months in the freezer at −18 °C (0 °F).
en.pantry: Cooked fresh ham has no room-temperature storage. Without curing salts there is nothing holding bacteria back once the joint cools into the danger zone of 4–60 °C (40–140 °F), and a large joint holds warmth for a long time in the middle. Get it into the fridge within two hours of coming out of the oven — one hour if the kitchen is above 32 °C (90 °F) — and carve it down or cut it into slabs first so it cools quickly rather than sitting warm for hours.
en.fridge: Keep it at 4 °C (40 °F) or below and eat it within 3–4 days. Store it in shallow covered containers or wrapped tightly, and carve only what you need so the rest keeps a sealed surface. Reheat leftovers until steaming hot all the way through rather than just taking the chill off, and do not put a joint back in the fridge after it has stood out on a buffet through a long lunch.
en.freezer: It keeps 3–4 months at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality. Slice or cube it first and freeze in flat, meal-sized bags with the air pressed out — a whole joint thaws slowly and unevenly, and lean roast pork dries out badly with freezer burn. Frozen food kept at −18 °C stays safe indefinitely; the months are a quality limit. Freeze it within the 3–4 day fridge window, not at the end of it.
en.thawing: Thaw in the fridge, allowing a day for a large piece, or in a sealed bag under cold running water. Never on the counter. Use thawed ham within a day or two and reheat it thoroughly.
spoilage: A sour or sulphurous smell when the container is opened.
A slimy or sticky film on the surface of the meat.
Liquid in the container gone cloudy or ropy.
tips: Carve a big joint down before chilling; a warm centre is what shortens its life.
Freeze in portions the day you cook it rather than at the end of the fridge window.
Keep the bone for stock and freeze that separately.
Label with the cooking date, not the freezing date, so you know how old the meat is.

faq.q: How long does cooked fresh ham keep in the fridge?
faq.a: 3–4 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, wrapped or in a covered container.

faq.q: Can you freeze cooked fresh ham?
faq.a: Yes, 3–4 months at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality. Slice or cube it first and freeze it flat.

faq.q: Is uncured ham the same as ordinary ham?
faq.a: No. Uncured fresh ham is just roast pork leg, with none of the curing salts that let a cured ham keep for weeks.

zh.name: 未醃漬熟火腿
zh.summary: 所謂「未醃漬的新鮮火腿」其實就是一支豬後腿——沒有醃漬鹽、沒有煙燻；烤熟之後它就是一般的熟肉。冷藏 4 °C 以下 3～4 天，冷凍 −18 °C 下 3～4 個月。
zh.pantry: 熟的新鮮火腿沒有常溫保存。少了醃漬鹽，肉塊降到 4～60 °C 的危險溫度帶時就沒有東西在擋細菌，而大塊肉的中心保溫很久。請在出爐後兩小時內進冰箱，廚房超過 32 °C 時縮為一小時；而且先切開或分成薄塊再冷藏，讓它快點降溫，不要整塊溫溫地放好幾個小時。
zh.fridge: 放 4 °C 以下，3～4 天內吃完。用淺盤加蓋或包緊保存，要吃多少切多少，剩下的保持完整表面。剩菜復熱要熱到中心冒蒸氣，不能只是去冰；在自助餐檯上放過整個午餐時段的肉塊，就不要再冰回去了。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下品質可維持 3～4 個月。先切片或切丁，按一餐份量壓平裝袋、壓出空氣——整塊解凍又慢又不均勻，而瘦的烤豬肉一凍傷就乾得很嚴重。−18 °C 下安全性是無限期的，月數是品質期限。要冷凍請在 3～4 天冷藏期的前段就凍，不要拖到最後一天。
zh.thawing: 放冷藏解凍，大塊請預留一天；或密封裝袋用冷水沖。不要放室溫退冰。解凍後一兩天內用完，並確實復熱。
spoilage: 打開容器聞到酸味或硫磺味。
肉的表面發黏、摸起來黏手。
出現灰綠色斑塊或任何霉點。
容器裡的湯汁變混濁或牽絲。
tips: 大塊肉先切開再冷藏；中心還溫熱正是壽命變短的原因。
煮好當天就分份冷凍，不要等冷藏期快到才凍。
骨頭留著熬湯，另外分開冷凍。
標上「烹調日期」而不是冷凍日期，才知道這塊肉實際多舊。

faq.q: 熟的新鮮火腿冷藏可以放多久？
faq.a: 包好或加蓋，放 4 °C 以下 3～4 天。

faq.q: 熟的新鮮火腿可以冷凍嗎？
faq.a: 可以，−18 °C 下 3～4 個月品質最好。先切片或切丁再壓平冷凍。

faq.q: 未醃漬火腿和一般火腿一樣嗎？
faq.a: 不一樣。未醃漬的新鮮火腿就是烤豬後腿，沒有那些能讓醃製火腿放好幾週的醃漬鹽。
